build_model_instantiate: build a Flax Model instance for predicting dates and regions from character sequences
create_t5_decoder_layer: create a T5DecoderLayer transformer block with self-attention and MLP for sequence processing
run_model_forward_pass: run the Model forward pass to produce date, region, mask, NSP, and UNK logits from text inputs
configure_bigbird_model: configure a BigBird-based Model with optional rotary positional embeddings and sparse attention
test_model_vision_mode: test the Model with vision inputs by combining ResNet image embeddings with text transformer outputs
